Watchman Lookout Station
tower
Die Watchman Lookout Station am Crater Lake diente als Feuerwachturm.
A Watchman Lookout Station a Crater Lake-nél tűzőrségi toronyként szolgált.
Stația de observare Watchman de la Crater Lake a fost folosită ca turn de veghe pentru incendii.
The Watchman Lookout Station at Crater Lake served as a fire lookout tower.
Crater Lake National Park
natural
Der Crater-Lake-Nationalpark beherbergt den tiefsten See der USA.
A Crater Lake Nemzeti Parkban található az USA legmélyebb tava.
Parcul Național Crater Lake găzduiește cel mai adânc lac din SUA.
Crater Lake National Park is home to the deepest lake in the United States.
